headline: Mohawk Industries (NYSE:MHK) Surges After Q2 Earnings Beat and Solid Guidance
summary: Mohawk Industries (MHK) beats Q2 estimates with $2.99B sales and $3.67 EPS, sending shares up 1.5% after-market.
